title: No Sale While a Reinstatement Right Runs — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Repossessions
content:
The sale of a vehicle repossessed under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract is not held while a reinstatement right is still running. The periods are counted in calendar days from the repossession date recorded on the contract; the state reinstatement period is the period recorded on the contract.

| Contract | The sale is anchored to |
|---|---|
| State reinstatement period recorded is longer than the company reinstatement window for the tier | the day after the state period ends |
| State period not longer than the window, and the contract shows fewer reinstatement payments than the tier's maximum reinstatements | the day after the company window ends |
| State period not longer than the window, and reinstatement payments at or above the tier's maximum | no anchor |

| Tier | Company reinstatement window (calendar days) | Maximum reinstatements |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 | 10 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 4 | 10 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 3 | 10 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2 | 15 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1 | 15 | 1 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 21 | 2 |

### Hypothetical cases (repossession on day 0, notice mailed on day 2)

- Tier 2 contract, no state period, no reinstatement payment: the window ends on day 15, the anchor is day 16, 14 days after the mailing date.
- Same contract with a state period of 30 days: the anchor is day 31, 29 days after the mailing date.
- Tier 3 contract, no state period, one earlier reinstatement payment (the maximum of 1 reached): no anchor.
- Tier 1+ contract, no state period, one earlier reinstatement payment (below the maximum of 2): the anchor is day 22, 20 days after the mailing date.
